words.enDefinition: A small lodging establishment offering rooms to paying guests

examples.en: We stayed at a guesthouse near the university during the conference.
examples.zh: 开会期间，我们住在大学附近的一家「小型旅馆」。

examples.en: The guesthouse sent us directions from the main train station.
examples.zh: 「小型旅馆」给我们发了从火车总站过去的路线。

words.enDefinition: A small lodging establishment providing overnight rooms and breakfast

examples.en: We chose a bed and breakfast near campus for the graduation weekend.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼那个周末，我们选了学校附近一家「含早餐的家庭旅馆」。

examples.en: The bed and breakfast had a small dining area on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 那家「含早餐的家庭旅馆」一楼有一个小用餐区。

collocations: stay at a bed and breakfast

words.enDefinition: Low-cost short-stay accommodation often offering shared sleeping rooms

examples.en: My classmates stayed at a youth hostel during the field trip.
examples.zh: 我们去实地考察时，同学们住在一家「青年旅舍」。

examples.en: The youth hostel listed its reception hours in the confirmation email.
examples.zh: 「青年旅舍」在确认邮件里写了前台开放时间。

collocations: a youth hostel near the station

words.enDefinition: Short-stay apartments combined with facilities or services associated with hotels

examples.en: The aparthotel had a small kitchen in each guest unit.
examples.zh: 那家「公寓式酒店」的每个客房单元都有一个小厨房。

examples.en: My friends chose an aparthotel because they wanted more space.
examples.zh: 朋友们想住得宽敞一些，就选了「公寓式酒店」。

words.enDefinition: Short-stay lodging with facilities for guests to make their own meals

examples.en: We booked self-catering accommodation for the weekend before the conference.
examples.zh: 我们为开会前的周末订了「可自行做饭的住宿」。

examples.en: The listing showed the kitchen available with the self-catering accommodation.
examples.zh: 住宿页面展示了这套「可自行做饭的住宿」配备的厨房。

words.enDefinition: A lodging business providing small individual sleeping pods to guests

examples.en: I tried a capsule hotel on a short trip with friends.
examples.zh: 我和朋友短途旅行时，体验了一次「胶囊旅馆」。

examples.en: The capsule hotel had a shared area for suitcases near reception.
examples.zh: 这家「胶囊旅馆」的前台附近有个共用的行李箱存放区。

collocations: a capsule hotel near the station

words.enDefinition: A guest room intended for one person to stay in

examples.en: I booked a single room for the night before my interview.
examples.zh: 我为面试前一晚订了间「单人客房」。

examples.en: The single room shown in the listing was on the top floor.
examples.zh: 住宿页面上那间「单人客房」在顶楼。

collocations: a single room for one night

words.enDefinition: A room intended for two guests, typically with one double bed

examples.en: I checked the bed details before booking a double room for us.
examples.zh: 我先核对了床型，然后给我们订了一间「双人床客房」。

examples.en: The double room in the photo had one bed beside the window.
examples.zh: 照片上的「双人床客房」有一张靠窗的床。

collocations: a double room for two guests

words.enDefinition: A guest room with two separate beds, typically singles

examples.en: My classmate and I booked a twin room for the conference.
examples.zh: 我和同学为参加会议订了一间「双床客房」。

examples.en: The twin room had one bed on either side of the window.
examples.zh: 「双床客房」的窗户两边各摆了一张床。

collocations: a twin room with two beds

words.enDefinition: A guest room advertised as having space for three people

examples.en: The three of us shared a triple room during the weekend.
examples.zh: 那个周末，我们三个人住在一间「三人客房」。

examples.en: The triple room had two beds and a separate pull-out bed.
examples.zh: 那间「三人客房」里有两张床，还有一张独立的抽拉床。

collocations: a triple room for three guests

words.enDefinition: A guest room furnished with at least one queen-size bed

examples.en: The booking page showed a queen room beside the twin option.
examples.zh: 预订页面把「大号床客房」和双床客房选项并排列出。

examples.en: My queen room had enough space for a desk near the door.
examples.zh: 我的「大号床客房」够宽敞，门边还放得下一张书桌。

collocations: a queen room on the upper floor

words.enDefinition: A guest room furnished with at least one king-size bed

examples.en: My roommate asked what bed size the king room actually had.
examples.zh: 室友想确认「特大号床客房」里的床实际上有多大。

examples.en: The hotel showed a king room with space for two large bags.
examples.zh: 酒店展示了一间放得下两个大包的「特大号床客房」。

collocations: a king room for one night

words.enDefinition: A guest room equipped to accommodate adults traveling with children

examples.en: My sister booked a family room while visiting me at university.
examples.zh: 姐姐来学校看我时，订了一间「家庭客房」。

examples.en: The family room had enough beds for my friend's whole family.
examples.zh: 「家庭客房」的床位足够我朋友全家人住。

collocations: a family room with extra beds

words.enDefinition: A guest room offered in a property's usual basic category

examples.en: I picked a standard room because I only needed one night.
examples.zh: 我只住一晚，所以选了一间「标准客房」。

examples.en: The standard room I booked overlooked the street where the café was.
examples.zh: 我订的「标准客房」能看到咖啡馆所在的那条街。

words.enDefinition: A room marketed as above the property's usual basic category

examples.en: I asked how a deluxe room differed from the standard option.
examples.zh: 我问「升级型客房」与标准客房有什么区别。

examples.en: The listing showed a deluxe room with a separate seating area.
examples.zh: 住宿页面展示了一间带独立休息区的「升级型客房」。

collocations: a deluxe room with a view

words.enDefinition: A larger guest unit with sleeping space and a sitting area

examples.en: My classmates shared a hotel suite during the graduation weekend.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼那个周末，同学们合住了一间「酒店套房」。

examples.en: We used the sitting area in the hotel suite to plan our trip.
examples.zh: 我们在「酒店套房」的休息区里商量行程。

collocations: a hotel suite with a living area

words.enDefinition: A larger guest room typically combining sleeping and sitting areas

examples.en: The junior suite had a small sofa beside the sleeping area.
examples.zh: 「小型套房」的睡眠区旁放着一张小沙发。

examples.en: I asked whether the junior suite included a separate bedroom door.
examples.zh: 我问「小型套房」里的卧室有没有单独的门。

collocations: a junior suite with a sofa

words.enDefinition: Guest rooms linked by a door inside the rooms

examples.en: My friend's family asked for connecting rooms when they visited campus.
examples.zh: 我朋友一家来学校探访时，问有没有「有内门相通的客房」。

examples.en: The photos showed the doors between the two connecting rooms.
examples.zh: 照片展示了两间「有内门相通的客房」之间的门。

words.enDefinition: Guest rooms situated side by side in the same building

examples.en: We requested adjoining rooms so we could knock on each other's doors.
examples.zh: 我们想住得近一点，方便敲门，就要了「相邻客房」。

examples.en: Our adjoining rooms shared a wall, but each had its own entrance.
examples.zh: 两间「相邻客房」共用一面墙，但各有自己的入口。

collocations: two adjoining rooms on one floor

words.enDefinition: A guest room with its own directly attached bathroom

examples.en: My friend picked an en-suite room for the night after graduation.
examples.zh: 朋友给毕业典礼后的那一晚订了间「带独立卫浴的客房」。

examples.en: The listing priced the en-suite room separately from the dorm beds.
examples.zh: 住宿页面把「带独立卫浴的客房」与多人间床位分开标价。

collocations: an en-suite room with a shower

words.enDefinition: An individual bed booked in a shared hostel sleeping room

examples.en: I booked a dorm bed for the night after the concert.
examples.zh: 我为音乐会结束后的那一晚订了一个「旅舍多人间床位」。

examples.en: My confirmation listed a dorm bed rather than the entire room.
examples.zh: 我的确认信息上写的是一个「旅舍多人间床位」，不是整个房间。

collocations: a dorm bed for one night

words.enDefinition: A shared hostel sleeping room with six individual beds

examples.en: I stayed in a six-bed dorm with three students from another university.
examples.zh: 我和另外一所大学的三名学生住在一间「六床多人间」。

examples.en: The hostel had a six-bed dorm on the floor above reception.
examples.zh: 旅舍在前台上一层有一间「六床多人间」。

collocations: book a bed in a six-bed dorm

words.enDefinition: A shared hostel room available to people of different genders

examples.en: We both booked beds in the same mixed dorm for Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们都订了星期六同一间「男女混住多人间」的床位。

examples.en: I checked whether the mixed dorm was on the same floor as reception.
examples.zh: 我核对了「男女混住多人间」和前台是不是在同一层。

collocations: book a bed in a mixed dorm
a mixed dorm at the hostel

words.enDefinition: A shared hostel sleeping room reserved for women guests

examples.en: My classmate booked a bed in a female-only dorm for the trip.
examples.zh: 同学为这趟旅行订了一张「仅限女性的多人间」床位。

examples.en: The website displayed the female-only dorm next to the other dorm options.
examples.zh: 网站把「仅限女性的多人间」和其他多人间选项并排列出。

collocations: book a bed in a female-only dorm

words.enDefinition: The bed positioned higher in a set of bunk beds

examples.en: My bed number was on the frame of the upper bunk.
examples.zh: 我的床号写在「上层床铺」的架子上。

examples.en: The hostel assigned me an upper bunk beside my friend's bed.
examples.zh: 旅舍给我安排了一个「上层床铺」，就在朋友的床旁边。

words.enDefinition: The bed positioned lower in a set of bunk beds

examples.en: My friend requested a lower bunk when booking her hostel bed.
examples.zh: 朋友订旅舍床位时，要求给她一个「下层床铺」。

examples.en: The label on the lower bunk was easier to see from the door.
examples.zh: 从门口更容易看清「下层床铺」上的标签。

words.enDefinition: An extra bed on wheels that can be moved or folded

examples.en: The hotel brought a rollaway bed when another friend joined us.
examples.zh: 又一位朋友加入后，酒店送来了一张「带轮移动加床」。

examples.en: I asked whether the room had space for a rollaway bed.
examples.zh: 我问客房里能不能放下一张「带轮移动加床」。

words.enDefinition: A small bed a lodging property provides for a baby

examples.en: My sister asked the hotel to provide a baby cot for her daughter.
examples.zh: 姐姐请酒店为她的女儿提供一张「旅店婴儿床」。

examples.en: The receptionist checked whether a baby cot was already in the room.
examples.zh: 前台人员确认客房里是否已经放了「旅店婴儿床」。

collocations: check availability of a baby cot

words.enDefinition: An accommodation arrangement or rate based on one guest staying

examples.en: The booking showed single occupancy even though the room had two beds.
examples.zh: 虽然房间有两张床，订单上还是写着「单人入住」。

examples.en: I asked whether the rate applied to single occupancy for that night.
examples.zh: 我问那个房价是否适用于当晚「单人入住」。

words.enDefinition: An accommodation arrangement or rate based on two guests staying

examples.en: The listing said the nightly rate was based on double occupancy.
examples.zh: 住宿页面注明，每晚房价按「双人入住」计算。

examples.en: I checked whether the double occupancy booking included both our names.
examples.zh: 我核对了「双人入住」的订单上有没有我们两个人的姓名。

words.enDefinition: The amount charged for one night of accommodation

examples.en: I checked the nightly rate before confirming our weekend stay.
examples.zh: 我核对了「每晚房价」，才确认周末的住宿订单。

examples.en: The email listed a different nightly rate for the second night.
examples.zh: 邮件为第二晚列了不同的「每晚房价」。

words.enDefinition: A price for accommodation without meals included in the rate

examples.en: We chose a room-only rate because breakfast was available on campus.
examples.zh: 学校有早餐可买，我们就选了「只含住宿的房价」。

examples.en: The booking screen listed the room-only rate below the breakfast option.
examples.zh: 预订页面在含早餐的选项下方列出了「只含住宿的房价」。

words.enDefinition: A booking label indicating breakfast forms part of the price

examples.en: The room was marked breakfast included on the hotel's website.
examples.zh: 酒店网站给这间客房标了「包含早餐」。

examples.en: I asked what breakfast included meant on our confirmation email.
examples.zh: 我问确认邮件里写的「包含早餐」具体指什么。

collocations: book a room with breakfast included

words.zhGloss: 含早餐和一顿正餐的住宿
words.enDefinition: Accommodation including breakfast and one other daily meal, usually dinner
acceptedZhAnswers: 含早餐和一顿正餐的住宿

examples.en: The hotel listed half board among the meal options for our stay.
examples.zh: 这家酒店的用餐选项中有「含早餐及另一正餐的住宿」。

examples.en: I asked which meals half board covered before confirming my stay.
examples.zh: 我问了「含早餐及另一正餐的住宿」具体包括哪两餐，才确认预订。

words.enDefinition: Accommodation with breakfast, lunch, and dinner included in the price

examples.en: The conference package listed full board with the overnight rooms.
examples.zh: 会议套餐里列出的客房是「含三餐的住宿」。

examples.en: My classmate asked whether full board applied on our last day.
examples.zh: 同学问最后一天是否仍算「含三餐的住宿」。

words.enDefinition: Accommodation combining meals and other specified services in one booking

examples.en: I checked what the all-inclusive stay covered before making a decision.
examples.zh: 作决定之前，我先核对了「全包式住宿」包含哪些服务。

examples.en: The email listed the services provided with our all-inclusive stay.
examples.zh: 邮件列出了我们的「全包式住宿」提供的服务。

words.enDefinition: The smallest number of nights a property accepts for a booking

examples.en: I checked the minimum stay before asking about a Saturday room.
examples.zh: 问星期六有没有房以前，我先查看了「最少入住晚数」。

examples.en: The listing showed a minimum stay for the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 住宿页面注明了节假日周末的「最少入住晚数」。

collocations: a minimum stay for certain dates

words.enDefinition: A view from a guest room looking over an inner courtyard

examples.en: I chose a room with a courtyard view to avoid the street.
examples.zh: 我选了有「内院景观」的客房，没有选临街房。

examples.en: The room photos showed the courtyard view from an upstairs window.
examples.zh: 客房照片展示了从楼上窗户看到的「内院景观」。

collocations: book a room with a courtyard view
a room offering a courtyard view

words.enDefinition: A change to a higher category of guest room

examples.en: The receptionist explained what the room upgrade would change about our booking.
examples.zh: 前台人员解释了这次「客房升级」会让我们的订单有哪些变化。

examples.en: I asked whether our room upgrade applied to both nights.
examples.zh: 我问我们的「客房升级」是不是两晚都适用。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement asking a lodging property to hold a room

examples.en: I made a hotel reservation after choosing a date for my visit.
examples.zh: 我确定到访日期后做了「酒店预订」。

examples.en: My friend checked whether the hotel reservation covered both nights of the conference.
examples.zh: 朋友核对了这项「酒店预订」是不是涵盖会议期间的两晚。

words.enDefinition: An email acknowledging the details of a hotel or hostel booking

examples.en: I opened the reservation confirmation email to check which property we had booked.
examples.zh: 我打开「订房确认邮件」，确认我们订的是哪家住宿。

examples.en: My roommate forwarded the reservation confirmation email before we left campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校前，室友把「订房确认邮件」转发给了我。

collocations: a copy of the reservation confirmation email

words.enDefinition: A reservation made on the first day of the planned stay

examples.en: We made a same-day booking after our last train was cancelled.
examples.zh: 末班列车取消后，我们临时「当天订当天入住」。

examples.en: I asked whether the hostel still accepted a same-day booking that evening.
examples.zh: 我问旅舍那天晚上还接不接受「当天订当天入住」。

words.enDefinition: A reservation paid for before arriving at the accommodation

examples.en: The receptionist looked up my prepaid booking when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到了以后，前台人员查了我的「预付房费的预订」。

examples.en: I kept the confirmation showing the dates of my prepaid booking.
examples.zh: 我留着确认信息，上面写着「预付房费的预订」的日期。

words.enDefinition: To pay the booking amount at the accommodation itself

examples.en: The confirmation said we would pay at the property after showing our booking.
examples.zh: 确认信息说，出示订单后我们要「到住宿地点付款」。

examples.en: I chose to pay at the property because my friend was handling the booking.
examples.zh: 朋友负责订房，我选择「到住宿地点付款」。

collocations: choose to pay at the property
prefer to pay at the property
an option to pay at the property

words.enDefinition: A price offered under terms that do not provide a refund

examples.en: I checked how the website labeled the non-refundable rate for that room.
examples.zh: 我查看了网站怎样标示该客房的「不可退款的房价」。

examples.en: The receptionist explained what the non-refundable rate on my confirmation meant.
examples.zh: 前台人员解释了我确认信息里的「不可退款的房价」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: An option allowing an eligible reservation to be cancelled without charge

examples.en: The listing showed free cancellation beside one of the room options.
examples.zh: 住宿页面在一个房型旁标了「免费取消预订」。

examples.en: I asked where the confirmation mentioned free cancellation for our booking.
examples.zh: 我问订单确认信息里哪里提到了「免费取消预订」。

words.enDefinition: The latest time a booking can be cancelled without a charge

examples.en: I checked which time zone the free-cancellation deadline used on my booking.
examples.zh: 我核对了订单上的「免费取消截止时间」用的是哪个时区。

examples.en: The confirmation listed the free-cancellation deadline beneath the room details.
examples.zh: 确认信息在客房详情下面写了「免费取消截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: To arrange to remain at an accommodation for additional nights

examples.en: The confirmation explains whom to contact to extend your stay at this hotel.
examples.zh: 确认信息说明了在这家酒店要找谁「延长住宿」。

examples.en: The manager explained how you could extend your stay without changing rooms.
examples.zh: 经理说明了怎样在同一间客房里「延长住宿」。

collocations: check whether you can extend your stay

words.enDefinition: To arrange to leave a property before the original departure date

examples.en: The guesthouse guide explains whom to contact if you shorten your stay.
examples.zh: 小旅馆指南写明了需要「缩短住宿」时该联系谁。

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether you wanted to shorten your stay by one night.
examples.zh: 前台人员问你是不是想「缩短住宿」，少住一晚。

collocations: check whether you can shorten your stay

words.expression: hold the room for late arrival
words.lemma: hold the room for late arrival
words.enDefinition: To keep a booked room available for a guest arriving late
acceptedEnVariants: hold the room for late arrival

examples.en: I asked whether the hotel could hold the room for late arrival after my train arrived.
examples.zh: 我问火车到站前，酒店能不能「为晚到旅客保留客房」。

examples.en: The booking included a note to hold the room for late arrival for our group.
examples.zh: 订单上有条备注，要「为晚到旅客保留客房」，指的是我们一行。

collocations: ask to hold the room for late arrival
agree to hold the room for late arrival
a note to hold the room for late arrival

words.enDefinition: A temporary card authorization covering possible additional hotel expenses

examples.en: I asked what the pending incidental hold in my card app referred to.
examples.zh: 我问银行应用显示的那笔待处理「酒店杂费预授权」指什么。

examples.en: The receptionist explained where the incidental hold appeared on my account.
examples.zh: 前台人员说明了「酒店杂费预授权」显示在账户的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: Additional amounts charged for optional items or services during a stay

examples.en: I checked which incidental charges were listed on the final statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了最终账单上列出的「住宿杂费」。

examples.en: The front desk asked which incidental charges I wanted explained.
examples.zh: 前台问我想了解哪几项「住宿杂费」。

words.enDefinition: A separately listed charge associated with staying at certain properties

examples.en: I asked what the resort fee on the hotel confirmation covered.
examples.zh: 我问酒店确认信息上的「度假酒店附加费」包括什么。

examples.en: The confirmation showed a resort fee on a separate line.
examples.zh: 确认信息单独列了一行「度假酒店附加费」。

collocations: ask what the resort fee covers

words.enDefinition: A local tax associated with overnight stays in some cities

examples.en: The hostel listed the city tax separately on our accommodation receipt.
examples.zh: 旅舍在我们的住宿收据上单列了「城市住宿税」。

examples.en: I asked whether the city tax appeared on each person's receipt.
examples.zh: 我问每个人的收据上是不是都列了「城市住宿税」。

words.enDefinition: A hotel record listing a guest's charges, credits, and payments

examples.en: I asked for a copy of my guest folio before leaving.
examples.zh: 我离开前要了一份「住客消费明细账」副本。

examples.en: The guest folio showed my room charge above the restaurant bill.
examples.zh: 「住客消费明细账」把我的客房费用列在餐厅账单上面。

words.enDefinition: The amount charged for using a particular guest room

examples.en: I checked the room charge against the rate on my booking.
examples.zh: 我把「客房费用」和订单上的房价核对了一下。

examples.en: The room charge appeared on the first line of the statement.
examples.zh: 「客房费用」出现在消费明细的第一行。

collocations: a room charge for one night

words.enDefinition: A request to add a purchase to one's hotel account

examples.en: I asked the server whether they could put it on my room after dinner.
examples.zh: 吃完晚饭，我问餐厅能不能「记到我的客房账上」。

examples.en: At the hotel café, I asked, "Could you put it on my room for now?"
examples.zh: 在酒店咖啡馆，我问店员能不能先把费用「记到我的客房账上」。

collocations: ask to put it on my room
say "Could you put it on my room?"
ask "Can you put it on my room?"

words.enDefinition: A record showing that someone stayed at an accommodation

examples.en: Our department asked for proof of stay after the conference trip.
examples.zh: 我们开完会回来后，院系要求提供「住宿证明」。

examples.en: The front desk printed my proof of stay before I left.
examples.zh: 我离开前，前台打印了我的「住宿证明」。

collocations: a letter serving as proof of stay

words.enDefinition: A hotel employee who assists guests at the reception desk

examples.en: The front desk agent checked my booking before handing me the key.
examples.zh: 「酒店前台接待员」查了我的订单，把钥匙交给了我。

examples.en: I asked the front desk agent whether my room faced the courtyard.
examples.zh: 我问「酒店前台接待员」，我的客房是否朝内院。

collocations: speak to a front desk agent
information from the front desk agent

words.enDefinition: The times when staff are available at a property's reception desk

examples.en: I checked the reception hours before booking a train that arrived late.
examples.zh: 我查了「前台开放时间」，才选了晚到的火车。

examples.en: The hostel posted its reception hours beside the main entrance.
examples.zh: 旅舍在正门旁贴出了「前台开放时间」。

words.enDefinition: A form recording basic details about people staying at a property

examples.en: The receptionist gave me a guest registration form for our group.
examples.zh: 前台人员给了我们一行一张「住客登记表」。

examples.en: I checked the dates on the guest registration form before handing it back.
examples.zh: 交回「住客登记表」前，我核对了上面的日期。

words.enDefinition: A person whose name is recorded as staying at a property

examples.en: The hotel emailed the directions to the registered guest named on the booking.
examples.zh: 酒店把路线发给了订单上的「已登记住客」。

examples.en: I checked whether my roommate was listed as a registered guest.
examples.zh: 我核对了室友是不是列为「已登记住客」。

collocations: a registered guest at the hotel

words.enDefinition: The published time for a guest to start checking in

examples.en: I checked the check-in time before booking our afternoon train.
examples.zh: 我先查看了「办理入住的时间」，才订我们的下午火车。

examples.en: The email showed a different check-in time from the original listing.
examples.zh: 邮件写的「办理入住的时间」与原住宿页面上的不同。

words.enDefinition: Arriving and taking a booked room before the usual arrival time

examples.en: We asked about early check-in because our train arrived before lunch.
examples.zh: 我们的火车午饭前就到，所以问了能不能「提前入住」。

examples.en: The early check-in option was shown under our booking details.
examples.zh: 订单详情下面列出了「提前入住」的选项。

words.enDefinition: Checking into accommodation later than the usual or expected arrival time

examples.en: I emailed about late check-in after our evening train was rescheduled.
examples.zh: 晚间列车改了时间后，我发邮件咨询能否「较晚办理入住」。

examples.en: Our booking included a note about late check-in on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们的订单里有一条关于星期五「较晚办理入住」的备注。

collocations: inform the hotel about late check-in

words.enDefinition: Checking in when the regular reception desk is closed

examples.en: We arranged after-hours check-in because reception would close before our train arrived.
examples.zh: 火车到达前前台就会关门，所以我们安排了「前台关门后入住」。

examples.en: I asked who to contact about after-hours check-in at the guesthouse.
examples.zh: 我问这家小旅馆「前台关门后入住」应该联系谁。

words.enDefinition: A way of checking in without using a staffed desk

examples.en: Our host sent the self check-in instructions before we left campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校前，接待方发来了「自助办理入住」的说明。

examples.en: I asked whether self check-in was available at the main entrance.
examples.zh: 我问正门那里能不能「自助办理入住」。

words.enDefinition: The process or result of allocating a particular room to a guest

examples.en: I checked the room assignment against the room type we booked.
examples.zh: 我拿预订的房型核对了「客房分配」。

examples.en: The hotel changed our room assignment after another room became available.
examples.zh: 另一间客房空出来以后，酒店更改了我们的「客房分配」。

words.enDefinition: The number identifying a particular guest room in a property

examples.en: I checked my room number on the envelope from reception.
examples.zh: 我查看了前台给的信封上的「客房号」。

examples.en: The porter asked for our room number before carrying the bags upstairs.
examples.zh: 行李员把包提上楼前，问了我们的「客房号」。

words.enDefinition: A key or electronic device used by a guest to enter their room

examples.en: The receptionist gave each of us a room key in an envelope.
examples.zh: 前台人员给了我们每人一把装在信封里的「客房钥匙」。

examples.en: I asked where to return the room key in the morning.
examples.zh: 我问早上要到哪里归还「客房钥匙」。

words.enDefinition: A plastic card giving a guest electronic access to a room

examples.en: The hotel key card came in a paper sleeve with the room details.
examples.zh: 「酒店房卡」装在一个写有客房信息的纸套里。

examples.en: I took my hotel key card back to reception because it stopped working.
examples.zh: 「酒店房卡」打不开门了，我就拿回了前台。

words.enDefinition: A digital credential on a device for accessing a guest room

examples.en: The app showed the digital room key beside my check-in details.
examples.zh: 应用把「电子客房钥匙」显示在我的入住信息旁边。

examples.en: I asked the front desk whether my booking offered a digital room key.
examples.zh: 我问前台，我的订单是否提供「电子客房钥匙」。

collocations: set up a digital room key

words.enDefinition: A box where guests can leave room keys when departing

examples.en: The key return box was located beside the door to reception.
examples.zh: 「客房钥匙归还箱」就在前台入口旁边。

examples.en: I asked where to find the key return box before leaving early.
examples.zh: 我一早离开之前，问了「客房钥匙归还箱」在哪里。

collocations: put keys in the key return box

words.enDefinition: The time by which a guest is expected to leave a room

examples.en: I checked the check-out time before arranging breakfast with my friend.
examples.zh: 约朋友吃早餐之前，我查了「最晚退房时间」。

examples.en: The check-out time was written on a note behind the door.
examples.zh: 「最晚退房时间」写在门后的一张提示纸上。

words.enDefinition: Permission to leave a guest room later than the normal departure time

examples.en: We asked about late checkout because our coach left in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们的长途大巴下午才发车，所以问了能不能「延迟退房」。

examples.en: The desk agent told me how to confirm my late checkout.
examples.zh: 前台接待员告诉我怎样确认自己的「延迟退房」。

words.enDefinition: An expedited process for leaving a property with fewer desk steps

examples.en: The hotel listed express checkout as an option on the welcome card.
examples.zh: 酒店在欢迎卡上把「快速退房」列为一个选项。

examples.en: I asked whether express checkout was available before my early train.
examples.zh: 我问一早去赶火车之前能不能「快速退房」。

words.enDefinition: Directions explaining what guests should do before leaving an accommodation

examples.en: The host sent the checkout instructions the evening before we left.
examples.zh: 接待方在我们离开的前一晚发来了「退房须知」。

examples.en: The checkout instructions explained where to leave our room keys.
examples.zh: 「退房须知」说明了客房钥匙要放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: Leaving an accommodation before the originally planned departure date

examples.en: I called the front desk after class to confirm my early departure.
examples.zh: 下课后，我打电话给前台，确认自己会「提前离店」。

examples.en: The early departure was recorded on the updated booking summary.
examples.zh: 更新后的订单概要记下了「提前离店」。

words.enDefinition: To leave luggage with staff at an accommodation's welcome desk

examples.en: The hostel told us we could leave your bags at reception before the room opened.
examples.zh: 旅舍说房间准备好之前可以「把行李寄存在前台」。

examples.en: I asked whether you could leave your bags at reception after giving back your key.
examples.zh: 我问你交回钥匙之后，能不能「把行李寄存在前台」。

collocations: ask to leave your bags at reception
offer to let you leave your bags at reception
choose to leave your bags at reception

words.enDefinition: A room used for temporarily storing luggage at accommodation

examples.en: The luggage room was behind reception and just beside the stairs.
examples.zh: 「行李存放室」在前台后面，就在楼梯旁。

examples.en: I asked whether the luggage room was available after we checked out.
examples.zh: 我问我们退房之后还能不能用「行李存放室」。

collocations: leave a bag in the luggage room

words.enDefinition: A lockable compartment provided for a guest's belongings

examples.en: My guest locker was large enough for a small backpack.
examples.zh: 我的「住客储物柜」够大，能放下一个小背包。

examples.en: The hostel assigned a guest locker with the same number as my bed.
examples.zh: 旅舍给我分配了一个编号与床号相同的「住客储物柜」。

collocations: a guest locker in the dorm

words.enDefinition: Assistance carrying luggage into or around a hotel

examples.en: I asked whether porter service was available for my friend's group.
examples.zh: 我问能不能给我朋友一行提供「行李搬运服务」。

examples.en: The welcome card listed porter service under the reception information.
examples.zh: 欢迎卡在前台信息下面列出了「行李搬运服务」。

words.enDefinition: The hotel service responsible for cleaning and preparing guest rooms

examples.en: I called housekeeping before bed to ask for an extra blanket.
examples.zh: 睡前，我打电话给「客房清洁服务」，请他们再送一条毯子。

examples.en: The hotel left a note about housekeeping beside our keys.
examples.zh: 酒店把关于「客房清洁服务」的提示放在我们的钥匙旁边。

words.enDefinition: A timetable showing when staff plan to clean guest rooms

examples.en: I checked the housekeeping schedule before deciding when to head out.
examples.zh: 我查了「客房清洁时间安排」，才决定什么时候出门。

examples.en: The hotel printed its housekeeping schedule on the welcome card.
examples.zh: 酒店在欢迎卡上印了「客房清洁时间安排」。

collocations: a change to the housekeeping schedule

words.enDefinition: To ask staff to provide clean towels during your stay

examples.en: The welcome note explained how to request fresh towels from the front desk.
examples.zh: 欢迎提示说明了怎么向前台「请换干净毛巾」。

examples.en: I called the service desk to request fresh towels for both of us.
examples.zh: 我给服务台打电话，请帮我们两个人「换干净毛巾」。

collocations: ask how to request fresh towels
use the app to request fresh towels

words.enDefinition: A sign telling hotel staff or other people not to enter

examples.en: The do not disturb sign was hanging on the inside of the door.
examples.zh: 「请勿打扰牌」挂在房门内侧。

examples.en: I put up the do not disturb sign while preparing for my presentation.
examples.zh: 我准备做报告时，挂上了「请勿打扰牌」。

collocations: hang the do not disturb sign
leave the do not disturb sign on the door
remove the do not disturb sign

words.enDefinition: To clean and prepare an occupied or recently used guest room

examples.en: I asked when housekeeping could make up the room after our meeting.
examples.zh: 我问开完会后，客房服务人员什么时候可以「打扫并整理房间」。

examples.en: The card said "Make up the room," so I left it on the door.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着「打扫并整理房间」，我把它挂在门上。

collocations: ask housekeeping to make up the room
a sign asking to make up the room
time to make up the room

words.enDefinition: A hotel service that delivers food or drinks to guest rooms

examples.en: My roommate looked at the room service menu while I unpacked.
examples.zh: 我收拾行李时，室友在看「客房送餐服务」的菜单。

examples.en: I called room service to ask when breakfast could be delivered.
examples.zh: 我打电话给「客房送餐服务」，问什么时候能把早餐送上来。

words.enDefinition: A scheduled call from a hotel intended to wake a guest

examples.en: I requested a wake-up call before my early interview the next morning.
examples.zh: 第二天一早要面试，我请酒店安排了「客房叫醒电话」。

examples.en: The front desk confirmed the time of my wake-up call.
examples.zh: 前台确认了我的「客房叫醒电话」时间。

words.enDefinition: A light morning meal often including bread and a drink

examples.en: I asked what the continental breakfast included at this guesthouse.
examples.zh: 我问这家小旅馆的「欧陆式早餐」包含什么。

examples.en: The continental breakfast was served in the lounge downstairs that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上的「欧陆式早餐」在楼下休息室供应。

words.enDefinition: A morning meal set out for guests to serve themselves

examples.en: Our group met at the breakfast buffet before walking to campus.
examples.zh: 我们去学校之前，在「自助早餐」区碰面。

examples.en: I checked when the breakfast buffet would open on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我查看了星期六「自助早餐」几点开始供应。

words.enDefinition: A hotel desk helping guests with local information and arrangements

examples.en: I picked up a city map from the concierge desk downstairs.
examples.zh: 我在楼下的「酒店礼宾台」拿了一张城市地图。

examples.en: The concierge desk told us which entrance led toward the university.
examples.zh: 「酒店礼宾台」告诉我们哪个出口通往大学方向。

collocations: a map from the concierge desk

words.enDefinition: A desk providing travelers with information about local tours

examples.en: I asked at the tour desk whether the museum ran guided visits.
examples.zh: 我在「旅游咨询台」问博物馆有没有导览。

examples.en: The hostel's tour desk had a map of the riverside walks.
examples.zh: 旅舍的「旅游咨询台」有一张河畔步行路线图。

words.enDefinition: A seating area in or adjoining a hotel's entrance hall

examples.en: I waited in the lobby lounge until my classmates arrived.
examples.zh: 我在「大堂休息区」等到同学们过来。

examples.en: We met in the lobby lounge before going out for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们先在「大堂休息区」碰面，再出去吃晚饭。

words.enDefinition: An area where guests can use machines to wash clothes

examples.en: I checked whether the guest laundry was on the same floor.
examples.zh: 我查了「住客自助洗衣区」是不是就在同一层。

examples.en: The hostel map showed the guest laundry near the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 旅舍示意图把「住客自助洗衣区」标在共用厨房附近。

words.enDefinition: A hotel service that collects and washes guests' clothes

examples.en: The front desk told me when laundry service was available.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我「衣物送洗服务」什么时候可以用。

examples.en: I asked where to leave my shirt for laundry service.
examples.zh: 我问要用「衣物送洗服务」，衬衫应该放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: A service lending towels to guests for a charge

examples.en: The hostel mentioned towel rental on its list of optional services.
examples.zh: 旅舍在可选服务清单上列了「毛巾租用」。

examples.en: I asked whether the reception desk handled towel rental for visitors.
examples.zh: 我问前台是否为住客办理「毛巾租用」。

words.enDefinition: A listing label indicating bedding such as sheets is supplied

examples.en: The listing said bed linen provided next to the dorm bed option.
examples.zh: 住宿页面在多人间床位选项旁写着「提供床上用品」。

examples.en: I saw bed linen provided under the information for our own room.
examples.zh: 我看到我们的客房信息下面写着「提供床上用品」。

collocations: a hostel with bed linen provided
an option marked bed linen provided

words.enDefinition: Personal washing products available to hotel guests without a separate charge

examples.en: The hotel placed complimentary toiletries in a basket beside the bathroom sink.
examples.zh: 酒店在浴室洗手池旁的篮子里放了「免费洗漱用品」。

examples.en: I checked whether the guesthouse listed complimentary toiletries with the room.
examples.zh: 我查看了小旅馆有没有在客房信息中列出「免费洗漱用品」。

words.enDefinition: Equipment and supplies provided inside a room for guests

examples.en: I checked the in-room amenities to see whether my room had a kettle.
examples.zh: 我查看了「客房内设施用品」清单，看看房间有没有水壶。

examples.en: The listing described the in-room amenities beneath the room photos.
examples.zh: 住宿页面在客房照片下面介绍了「客房内设施用品」。

words.enDefinition: A lockable box inside a hotel room for storing guest belongings

examples.en: The room description showed an in-room safe inside the wardrobe.
examples.zh: 客房介绍显示，衣柜里有一个「客房保险箱」。

examples.en: I asked the receptionist where to find the in-room safe.
examples.zh: 我问前台人员「客房保险箱」放在什么位置。

words.enDefinition: A small supply of drinks and snacks provided inside a hotel room

examples.en: The confirmation listed a minibar among the room amenities on offer.
examples.zh: 确认信息在所提供的客房设施下列了「客房迷你吧」。

examples.en: I asked which of the drinks in the room were from the minibar.
examples.zh: 我问房间里的饮料有哪些是「客房迷你吧」提供的。

words.enDefinition: A machine making or dispensing ice for people to use

examples.en: Our hotel map showed an ice machine near the elevator.
examples.zh: 酒店示意图在电梯附近标出了「制冰机」。

examples.en: I asked which floor had the ice machine for guests.
examples.zh: 我问哪层有供住客使用的「制冰机」。

words.zhGloss: 可推轮椅进入的淋浴间
words.enDefinition: A shower designed for wheelchair entry without a raised step
acceptedZhAnswers: 可推轮椅进入的淋浴间

examples.en: The room photos showed a roll-in shower beside the bathroom sink.
examples.zh: 客房照片里，浴室洗手池旁有「可推轮椅进入的淋浴间」。

examples.en: I asked the hotel to confirm the roll-in shower in our room.
examples.zh: 我请酒店确认，我们的客房有没有「可推轮椅进入的淋浴间」。

collocations: book a room with a roll-in shower

words.enDefinition: An outdoor area on a building's roof used by guests

examples.en: We went up to the rooftop terrace after breakfast at the hostel.
examples.zh: 我们在旅舍吃完早餐后去了「屋顶露台」。

examples.en: The map showed how to reach the rooftop terrace from reception.
examples.zh: 示意图标出了从前台怎么到「屋顶露台」。

collocations: a hostel with a rooftop terrace

words.enDefinition: A room fitted with equipment for exercise inside a property

examples.en: The welcome card listed the opening times for the fitness room.
examples.zh: 欢迎卡上写了「小型健身房」的开放时间。

examples.en: My classmate asked whether the fitness room was open that morning.
examples.zh: 同学问「小型健身房」那天早上是否开放。

words.enDefinition: A kitchen accommodation makes available for people staying there

examples.en: The hostel showed us the guest kitchen before we went upstairs.
examples.zh: 我们上楼前，旅舍工作人员给我们指了「住客厨房」。

examples.en: My classmates made breakfast together in the guest kitchen before leaving.
examples.zh: 同学们离开前在「住客厨房」一起做了早餐。

words.enDefinition: A room where people staying at an accommodation can sit together

examples.en: We talked in the shared lounge after the conference finished.
examples.zh: 会议结束后，我们在「共用休息室」里聊了一会儿。

examples.en: The shared lounge had shelves with books and a few games.
examples.zh: 「共用休息室」的架子上有书和几盒游戏。

collocations: a hostel with a shared lounge

words.enDefinition: Usable room on a desk for writing or working

examples.en: I checked the photos for desk space before booking the room.
examples.zh: 订房之前，我看了照片确认「书桌可用空间」有多大。

examples.en: There was enough desk space for my laptop and one notebook.
examples.zh: 「书桌可用空间」够大，放得下我的笔记本电脑和一本笔记本。

words.enDefinition: An additional blanket kept available for a guest to use

examples.en: I asked whether the room had a spare blanket for my friend.
examples.zh: 我问房间里有没有「备用毯子」可以给朋友用。

examples.en: The welcome note showed where to find a spare blanket.
examples.zh: 欢迎提示写了到哪里可以找到「备用毯子」。

collocations: a spare blanket in the wardrobe

words.enDefinition: An additional pillow supplied beyond those already in a room

examples.en: My roommate called reception to ask for an extra pillow.
examples.zh: 室友打电话给前台，问能不能「加一只枕头」。

examples.en: The hotel brought an extra pillow before we returned from dinner.
examples.zh: 我们吃晚饭回来前，酒店已经送来了「额外的枕头」。

words.enDefinition: To move from one guest room to another during a stay

examples.en: I asked to change rooms because the room faced the main road.
examples.zh: 因为客房朝着主路，我问能不能「换客房」。

examples.en: The front desk offered to let us change rooms after breakfast.
examples.zh: 前台说早餐后可以让我们「换客房」。

collocations: offer to let a guest change rooms

words.enDefinition: A message indicating that a booked room cannot yet be occupied

examples.en: My booking screen showed "Room not ready," so I waited in reception.
examples.zh: 订单页面显示「客房还没准备好」，我就在前台区域等。

examples.en: The message said "Room not ready" when we arrived before lunch.
examples.zh: 我们午饭前到达时，消息显示「客房还没准备好」。

collocations: tell guests their room is not ready
a room not ready at check-in
a note marked room not ready

words.enDefinition: A notice saying the accommodation has no guest rooms available

examples.en: The sign read "No vacancies," so we checked the next guesthouse.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着「没有空房」，我们就去看下一家小旅馆。

examples.en: I saw "No vacancies" on the hostel's booking page that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我在旅舍预订页看到「没有空房」。

words.enDefinition: A service desk that helps people recover items they left behind

examples.en: I called the lost property desk after leaving my scarf at the hotel.
examples.zh: 我把围巾落在酒店，就给「失物招领服务台」打了电话。

examples.en: The receptionist told me where to find the lost property desk nearby.
examples.zh: 前台人员告诉我附近哪里有「失物招领服务台」。

collocations: ask at the lost property desk
a message from the lost property desk

words.enDefinition: Design details helping guests with access needs use a room

examples.en: The booking page listed accessible room features beside a bathroom photo.
examples.zh: 预订页面在一张浴室照片旁列了「无障碍客房设施」。

examples.en: I asked which accessible room features were available on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 我问一楼有哪些「无障碍客房设施」。

collocations: a list of accessible room features

words.enDefinition: A phrase used to report an item left by someone

examples.en: I said "Someone left this behind" and handed the scarf to the receptionist.
examples.zh: 我说「有人落下了这个」，把围巾交给前台人员。

examples.en: My roommate said "Someone left this behind" after finding a book near the sofa.
examples.zh: 室友在沙发旁发现一本书后说「有人落下了这个」。

collocations: say "Someone left this behind in the lounge."

words.enDefinition: A guest room on the level nearest the ground outside

examples.en: My sister requested a ground-floor room because she had a stroller.
examples.zh: 姐姐带着婴儿车，所以要求订一间「地面层客房」。

examples.en: The guesthouse confirmed a ground-floor room near the front door.
examples.zh: 小旅馆确认有一间靠近正门的「地面层客房」。

words.enDefinition: The category describing a guest room's beds, layout, or features

examples.en: I checked the room type before sending the reservation to my roommate.
examples.zh: 我核对了「预订房型」，才把订单转发给室友。

examples.en: The front desk asked which room type we had reserved online.
examples.zh: 前台问我们网上订的是哪种「预订房型」。

words.enDefinition: The kind or arrangement of beds a guest would prefer

examples.en: I entered my bed preference after selecting the dates of my stay.
examples.zh: 选好住宿日期后，我填写了「床型偏好」。

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether our bed preference had changed since booking.
examples.zh: 前台人员问，我们的「床型偏好」在订房后有没有变化。

words.enDefinition: A formal change to the details of an accommodation booking

examples.en: The hotel sent a reservation amendment email after we changed dates.
examples.zh: 我们改过日期后，酒店发了一封「订房信息修改」的邮件。

examples.en: I asked whether the reservation amendment changed which room we would get.
examples.zh: 我问「订房信息修改」后，给我们的房间是否也会变。

words.enDefinition: Directions explaining where or when guests can get their keys

examples.en: I read the key collection instructions while waiting at the train station.
examples.zh: 我在火车站等车时看了「领取钥匙须知」。

examples.en: The guesthouse sent separate key collection instructions before our arrival that evening.
examples.zh: 我们那天晚上到达前，小旅馆另外发了份「领取钥匙须知」。

words.enDefinition: A guest room where smoking is prohibited by the accommodation

examples.en: I checked whether the non-smoking room was listed on my confirmation.
examples.zh: 我核对了确认信息上有没有列出「禁烟客房」。

examples.en: The agent confirmed a non-smoking room for my friend's short stay.
examples.zh: 接待员确认给我朋友的这次短住安排了「禁烟客房」。

words.enDefinition: A guest room that looks onto a road or street

examples.en: I asked whether the street-facing room had windows we could open.
examples.zh: 我问「临街客房」的窗户能不能打开。

examples.en: Our street-facing room looked onto the street beside the railway station.
examples.zh: 我们的「临街客房」正对着火车站旁边那条街。

collocations: a street-facing room on the second floor

words.enDefinition: Unable to enter one's room because the door is locked

examples.en: I told reception I was locked out of my room after my card stopped working.
examples.zh: 房卡失灵后，我告诉前台我「被锁在自己房间外」。

examples.en: I asked for help when I found myself locked out of my room again.
examples.zh: 我发现自己又「被锁在自己房间外」，就去找人帮忙。

collocations: get locked out of my room
say "I'm locked out of my room."
call reception when locked out of my room
